list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned; 0 online trophies. Names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, the two agreeing on every entry.

KGM.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

PSN.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: There is nothing extra to do for this one: it pops by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so it is always the last trophy of the run. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup — and the platinum arrives on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the first mission of the game, so this trophy pops early in Chapter 1 with no preparation needed — just follow the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically as you play through the story, so there is no way to miss this one as long as you keep playing the main missions.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks automatically when the chapter's story is done, so just keep playing the main missions in order.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 3. It pops automatically at the end of the chapter, so no side content is needed for it — the story alone does it.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it unlocks automatically when the chapter's story missions are complete.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission. This gold trophy marks the end of the main story; after it you return to the open world and can keep cleaning up everything else in free-roam.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies like this one pop automatically when the mission ends, so play it through as part of the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission, so the trophy pops automatically when you finish it — no extra objective is needed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every named-mission trophy, it unlocks on its own when the mission is done.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The trophy pops automatically at the end of the mission, as part of the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Finish the mission and the trophy follows on its own.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, found under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion once the story is finished. The checklist is kinder than it sounds: progress you make during the story already counts, and it is closer to 60% true completion — you only need 70 of the 80 challenges, and most side quests are not required. PowerPyx rates this the hardest trophy of the set, so expect it to be the long grind of the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, airtime and the like all count, and there are 397 stunts in the world, with 300 needed for 100% completion. Stunts build up naturally while driving around, so play normally first and clean up the remainder in free-roam afterwards.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each of the game's nine activity types — fishing, bowling, the arcade, the shooting range, drone races, racing, meditation, hunting and the rest. Most of them are covered while chasing other trophies, so this one usually pops on its own during the story; if it has not, sample whichever activity type you have never touched.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. Every range must be golded — there is no partial credit — so work through the ranges one at a time, learn each one's targets and timing, and redo any challenge that lands silver or bronze. Shooting ranges are also required in full for 100% completion, so this trophy and the checklist go together.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. You only need one win per location for the trophy, but 100% completion wants all 42 drone races, so winning every race kills two birds with one stone. Learn each course's racing line before pushing for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Winning the same race twice does not count, so keep moving to new races instead of repeating a favourite. Pick a fast car you trust and work through the race list.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. Fish against Cal, watch the challenge's scoring, and keep at it until you out-fish him — fishing is one of the nine activity types, so it also counts toward Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play an arcade game through to its end. Any arcade machine in Leonida will do — pick a game, finish it, and the trophy pops. Do it early: it is one of the nine activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Side-character strands unlock as the story advances; play Andy's missions whenever they appear and the trophy pops when his last one ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Play his missions as they appear during the story and the trophy pops when the strand ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. His missions appear as the story advances — clear them when they show up and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. Not every stranger counts: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are among the strands that count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not. Work through the strangers you meet in the open world after the story and keep count — eight qualifying strands is the mark.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Clear his missions as they appear and the trophy pops when his strand ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. His missions appear during the story — play them when they show up and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations, as Jason and as Lucia. This is the one trophy every guide flags as possibly missable: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, and it is reported to be gone after that chapter, with no mission replay in the game. Whether that first spot is strictly required is unconfirmed — but the safe play is to meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, then work through the other 17 spots at your leisure.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Follow Bret's quests — they are one of the few things 100% completion wants in full — and take down the unique animal when his strand points you at it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three full sets of collectible cards. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so pick them up as you explore and keep track of which sets are still short a card. Three finished sets is the mark — you do not need every card in the game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. This is a pure exploration count: the more of Leonida you cover, the faster it climbs. Sweep through towns and landmarks you have not visited yet to finish the last locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges, in eight groups of ten. You may skip the hardest ones — 100% completion wants 70, so the 50 for this trophy leave plenty of room to dodge the challenges you hate most. Work through the easy groups first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level and then lose the police and escape. Get the stars up, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the heat dies down — a fast car and a quiet corner of the map help.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.target: Escape a 4-star wanted level with your partner

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Plan a route between three close shops, hit them one after another, and keep moving — if the wanted level drops between robberies, the chain breaks and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.target: 3 shops in a row, wanted level kept

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Driving new cars, bikes, boats and planes as you find them builds the count; studying vehicles through the binoculars helps track them — 100% completion wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so the trophy is the easy half of that job.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up first: gather a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them quickly before it ends. A busy shootout is the easiest place to line up five targets at once.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — take a plane or helicopter out without following a scheduled departure. The exact trigger is still being pinned down by players, so try departing in an aircraft from the airport grounds rather than through the terminal routine.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: No verified method yet. The description points at Rhino tanks, but how the trophy triggers — surviving them, driving one, or taking them on — has not been confirmed by a citable guide at the time of writing. Treat this one as unconfirmed and check the sources below for updates rather than following a guess.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid the guards' sightlines and the cameras, take what you came for, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five of the eight bank vaults and escape each time. The vaults open up after an optional Chapter 4 mission, and every vault robbery brings a 4-star wanted level, so have a fast getaway vehicle ready before you go in. Five vaults is enough for the trophy — the other three are only needed for 100%.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, get it open, take the cash and break away before the police box you in. Any armored truck counts.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The count ticks up as you set foot in each named area, so this one is finished by thorough travel: drive the highways, visit the small towns, the islands and the backwoods, and check the map for any area you have never entered.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Find each gang's operations around Leonida, hit one per gang, and keep a note of which gangs you have covered — the trophy needs all nine.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy is about the moment, not a mission. The precise spot is still being pinned down, so try the beachfront bars first.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car through the showroom's front and out onto the street. The reported method is to get a car inside a showroom and floor it through the glass; the exact showroom is still being confirmed by players.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the alley, start a game and follow through — the trophy is about playing there, not about a perfect score. Bowling is also one of the nine activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: No verified method yet. The description hints at a partnership moment with mass appeal, but no citable guide has confirmed what triggers it. Treat this one as unconfirmed and check the sources below for updates rather than following a guess.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices as you play the story — PSN tracks a count toward 500 of them. There is no single choice that pops this trophy; it builds up across the story's decisions, so just keep playing and choosing, and it will come.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No verified method yet. The description suggests succeeding at something on the second try, but which attempt counts has not been confirmed by a citable guide. Treat this one as unconfirmed and check the sources below for updates.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No verified method yet. The description reads like a strange random event — players suspect something out of the ordinary in the open world — but nothing has been confirmed by a citable guide. Treat this one as unconfirmed and check the sources below for updates.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The reported method is to swing a melee weapon at a pedestrian from a slow-moving vehicle, but the precise conditions are still being confirmed by players, so expect this one to take a few tries.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so keep laundering what you earn as you play — the total builds up across the whole run and there is no need to grind it in one go.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Everything you buy counts — clothes, food, ammo, cars — so this one climbs on its own as you play. If it is the last one standing, buy big-ticket items you actually want rather than wasting money.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress and earn money; buy each one when it appears. Eight is the full set, and the money is easiest to find after the story's bigger payouts.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the app and register each one — ten registrations is the mark, and any ten vehicles count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
